name: rdl-agent-workspace

scripts.server: bun run ui && bun apps/desktop/src/main.ts serve
scripts.check: biome lint ./ && biome check ./ && biome format ./
scripts.build: bun run ui && hutch electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.build:canary: bun run ui && hutch electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.build:dev: bun run ui && hutch electrobun build --env=dev

//build: One bundle IS the whole app. Electrobun packages a Bun runtime at <app>/bin/bun and the main process at <app>/Resources/app/bun/index.js, so `<app> serve` and the per-session `mcp-shim` are reached by re-execing process.execPath against Bun.main — neither loads the native window wrapper, so both run headless. The UI is built by Vite (Hutch cannot serialise the Tailwind plugin across its config boundary) into apps/desktop/dist and copied to views/mainview, then served by the app's own loopback server so UI and API share an origin. Still needs poppler-utils + ImageMagick for PDF text/raster feedback — off PATH, or via $LAYOUT_TOOLS_DIR. Hutch does not cross-compile: run the build on a native runner per target. Linux additionally needs gtk3, webkit2gtk-4.1, libayatana-appindicator and librsvg at runtime.
